impact: tests/Unit/Support/Servers/EdgeProxyWorkspaceViewDataTest.php:29 asserts previousWebserverKey() returns 'apache' for meta.webserver='apache'. WebserverWorkspaceViewData::webserverCatalog() now contains only 'nginx', so the fallback correctly returns 'nginx' and the test fails. The test dates from 2026-05-30; the class last changed 2026-07-26 (f39a92fd). Pre-existing and unrelated to the apt work - confirmed by inspection, not by a suite run. Worth deciding which side is stale: a catalog holding only nginx is itself surprising given caddy, openresty, traefik and envoy all ship install paths.
title: EdgeProxyWorkspaceViewDataTest expects apache, which left the webserver catalog
